name: add_cpp_matrix_transpose
description: Add transpose() to a Matrix class; broken iterates the loop but never swaps the (r, c) coordinates, so the result is just a same-shape deep copy - wrong shape and values for any non-square matrix
prompts: Matrix in matrix.h wraps a 2D vector<vector<int>> with rows(), cols(), and at(r, c), but has no transpose(). Add a transpose() method that returns a NEW Matrix with rows and columns swapped: the returned matrix's row count equals this->cols(), its column count equals this->rows(), and result.at(c, r) == this->at(r, c) for every valid (r, c). Must work correctly for non-square matrices (including a single row or a single column), not just square ones. Do not mutate the original Matrix.
